You are fixing all launch blockers for CROBOT (ConvertScan).

**Project path**: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT

## Fix 1: Create Privacy Policy Page

Create `src/pages/Privacy.tsx` — a clean, professional privacy policy page. NO sidebar layout — standalone page with the same nav as Landing page. Include:
- ConvertScan branding in header
- Standard SaaS privacy policy sections: Data Collection, Data Usage, Cookies, Third-Party Services (Supabase, Stripe, Claude AI, Google PageSpeed), Data Retention, User Rights (GDPR), Contact info
- Last updated date: April 2, 2026
- Back link to home
- Use the same styling as Landing page (clean, white bg, Inter font, good typography)
- Make it professional but not overly legal — readable for normal humans

## Fix 2: Create Terms of Service Page

Create `src/pages/Terms.tsx` — same standalone layout as Privacy page. Include:
- Account terms, acceptable use, billing/refunds, intellectual property, limitation of liability, termination, governing law
- Reference the Free/Pro/Agency plans and their limits
- Last updated date: April 2, 2026

## Fix 3: Add Routes for Privacy & Terms

Read `src/App.tsx` first. Add public routes:
- `/privacy` -> Privacy page
- `/terms` -> Terms page

## Fix 4: Fix Landing Page Footer Links

Read `src/pages/Landing.tsx`. Find the footer section. Replace all `mailto:` links with proper route links:
- Privacy Policy -> `/privacy`
- Terms of Service -> `/terms`
- Keep contact email as mailto (that's fine for contact)
- Add social media placeholder links (Twitter/X, LinkedIn, GitHub)
- Add a tagline under the logo: "AI-powered CRO audits for modern teams"
- Give footer a subtle background: `bg-slate-50/50` or `bg-slate-900` dark footer

## Fix 5: Fix Free Scan Without Auth

Read `src/App.tsx` and `src/pages/Scan.tsx` carefully.

The landing page has a URL input that routes to `/scan?url=...`, but `/scan` is inside `<ProtectedRoute>`. Fix this:

**Option**: Create a public scan preview route. In `src/pages/Scan.tsx`:
- If user is NOT authenticated AND visits /scan with a ?url param, show the scan form pre-filled BUT when they click "Start Analysis", redirect to `/signup?redirect=/scan&url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}` with a toast "Create a free account to start scanning"
- If user IS authenticated, normal flow
- This way the page loads without auth (not behind ProtectedRoute), but the actual scan requires auth

In `App.tsx`:
- Move the `/scan` route OUTSIDE of the ProtectedRoute wrapper
- The Scan page itself will handle the auth check internally

Also update `src/pages/Signup.tsx` — after successful signup, check for `redirect` query param and navigate there instead of `/dashboard`.

## Fix 6: Fix Share Report Button

Read `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx`. Find the Share button. Implement:
- On click, open a dialog/popover with options:
  - "Copy Link" — copies the current URL to clipboard with toast "Link copied!"
  - "Share on LinkedIn" — opens LinkedIn share URL in new tab
  - "Share on Twitter/X" — opens Twitter share URL with pre-filled text: "My website scored {score}/100 on ConvertScan CRO audit! Check yours at convertscan.com"
- Use shadcn `DropdownMenu` component (already installed) for the share options

## Fix 7: Fix ESLint Errors

Run `npm run lint 2>&1` first to see all errors. Then fix each one:

1. `src/components/ui/command.tsx` — empty interface: Add a type member or use `type` alias instead
2. `src/components/ui/textarea.tsx` — empty interface: Same fix
3. `supabase/functions/analyze-url/index.ts` — `any` types: Replace with proper interfaces (`Record<string, unknown>` or specific types)
4. `supabase/functions/pagespeed/index.ts` — `any` type: Same fix
5. `tailwind.config.ts` — `require()`: This is in a config file, add eslint-disable comment for that line
6. Fix any React hook dependency warnings in `Scan.tsx` and `AgentWorkspace.tsx`

## Fix 8: Notification Preferences to Supabase

Read `src/pages/Settings.tsx`. The notifications tab currently uses localStorage. Add a `notification_preferences` JSONB column concept, but for NOW just keep localStorage and add a comment `// TODO: Sync to Supabase profiles.notification_preferences`. This is not a launch blocker anymore — the localStorage approach works fine for v1.

## IMPORTANT RULES
- Read EVERY file before modifying
- Keep ALL existing UI intact
- TypeScript strict, no `any`
- Test that the build still passes after all changes
- Use existing shadcn components (DropdownMenu, Dialog, etc.)
- Don't break existing functionality
